coverage_claim: WM-DAT-007 covers one governed data-quality assessment from identity, subject and purpose through quality models, metrics, rules, sampling, methods, observations, results, purpose-qualified verdicts, evidence, conflicts, issues, remediation references, lifecycle, access, records and projections. Domain-specific profiles, restricted standard clauses and independent external review remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a versioned assessment aggregate containing definitions, observations, results, verdicts and review history. It remains distinct from the assessed subject, validation run, metric registry, certificate, issue and remediation action.

decisions.rationale: Every verdict binds a subject version, population, consumer, use case, decision, time and limits; no universal quality state is asserted.
The Dataset signal identifies the assessed subject, but the incoming candidate COMPOSE edge is not approved and grants no ownership, mutation or cascade authority.
Metric, rule, measurement activity, observation, result, score, verdict, certificate, issue and remediation action remain distinct.
A validation result applies only to its exact schema, shape, rule set, subject version and execution; conformance is not universal fitness.
Population, frame, sample, strata, coverage, weights, bias, reference period, missingness and uncertainty must be explicit before aggregation.
Unknown, unavailable, not applicable, not measured, not run, warning, failure, accepted and waived states cannot be collapsed.
The assessment links findings, issue and action identities but does not execute remediation, close issues or infer effectiveness from status.
Review, certification, publication, withdrawal, risk acceptance and access decisions require accountable authority.
ISO/IEC 25012, ISO/IEC 25024, ISO 8000-8 and ISO 19157-1 support only public metadata or preview claims; inaccessible clauses are not inferred.
DQV, DCAT, PROV, SHACL, JSON Schema, SSN, ISO, UN, OECD, NIST, QUDT and time mappings pin versions and declare loss.

One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audits the frozen validated result and comparison locally without tools or new research facts; assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-DAT-007 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external research result was admitted.
Relation hold: the WM-DAT-001 parent signal and incoming candidate COMPOSE relation are not approved frozen composition edges and grant no ownership, mutation or cascade behavior.
Purpose hold: fitness, importance, thresholds, weighting, aggregation and acceptance depend on the declared consumer, use case, decision, subject version, population and time.
Method hold: sampling frame, coverage, bias, missingness, reference values, measurement error, uncertainty and reproducibility require domain-qualified methods.
Conformance hold: passing a schema, shape, rule or validation run does not prove universal correctness, completeness, quality, safety or absence of harm.

Authority hold: production-data mutation, contract changes, pipeline execution, threshold changes, access widening, certification, issue closure, remediation execution, publication and records disposition require delegated authority.
Privacy hold: personal or sensitive source data, row-level violations, proprietary rules, protected evidence and unpublished verdicts require purpose-bound access and minimization.
Restricted-source hold: ISO/IEC 25012, ISO/IEC 25024, ISO 8000-8 and ISO 19157-1 were used only at public metadata or preview level; access-restricted clauses were not inspected or inferred.
Interoperability hold: DQV, DCAT, PROV, SHACL, JSON Schema, SSN, ISO, UN, OECD, NIST, QUDT, OWL-Time and RFC projections require release pins, conformance tests and information-loss declarations.
deferred_research: Approve or reject the WM-DAT-001 composition relation and register Data Product, Data Contract, Schema, Pipeline, Run, Metric Registry, Issue, Remediation, Certificate, Evidence, Audit and Records edges.
Create domain, subject-type, quality-framework, sampling, metric, uncertainty, verdict, certification, privacy, jurisdiction and organizational profiles.
Conformance-test metric formulas, units, thresholds, aggregation, missing-state behavior, uncertainty and reproducibility against concrete engines and reference datasets.
Validate organization-specific access, row-level evidence, data-subject rights, publication, risk acceptance, legal hold, retention and disposition policies.
Test version-pinned DQV, DCAT, PROV, SHACL, JSON Schema, SSN, ISO, UN, OECD, NIST, QUDT and time mappings and obtain independent external review before canonical promotion.
